title: emg2pose: Surface EMG and Hand Pose
description: This dataset is a NEMAR re-host and BIDS conversion of the emg2pose benchmark, comprising surface electromyography (EMG) recordings paired with hand pose labels for wrist-worn sEMG-based hand pose estimation. It includes 16-channel, 2 kHz sEMG recordings synchronized with joint-angle labels derived from a 26-camera motion-capture rig, spanning 193 users, 370 hours, and approximately 80 million labeled frames across 29 behavioral stages.
methods_description: Surface EMG was recorded at 2 kHz across 16 channels from the wrist, paired with hand pose labels derived from a 26-camera motion-capture rig using inverse kinematics to produce 20 joint-angle channels. The data were converted from the original HDF5 format to EMG-BIDS BDF files, with joint angles stored as radian-valued MISC channels and BAD_IK annotations marking invalid inverse-kinematics samples.
